info.name: SmartNews Marketing ad smart view article keyword API
Batch search SmartView article keyword suggestions

items.docs:
Accepts a list of keywords and returns preset SmartView article keyword
suggestions for each, suitable for autocomplete experiences.

- Input is language-agnostic: both EN and JA queries are supported.
- Results may contain both EN and JA keywords (exact and similar matches).
- Results for each keyword are sorted by relevance in descending order.
- When no matches are found for a keyword, an empty array is returned for that key.
